mechanism_defects.name: guard_lookup_outcome_missing
mechanism_defects.what: GuardCheck accepts lookups, but guards._candidate_context publishes only matched cells under the alias and never lookup.<alias> (matched/not_found), unlike obligations._context (mechanism 3). A guard condition on lookup.bank == 'not_found' is always unknown, so a violating effect scores unknown instead of 1.0.
mechanism_defects.workaround_used: prohibited_when = proven(amounts differ) or not proven(alias key equals request key)
mechanism_defects.fix_sketch: Publish lookup.<alias> in guard contexts exactly as obligations do (decided outcomes only).

limitations: Accepted false zeros (verified): one-line summaries that pair every reference with every category, and block/grouped reports without blank lines.
P4-ref accepts the QB Id because no QuickBooks read exposes payment_number (environment defect); P5, P7, P8a and P8b are interpretive constraints for a report-only request and need sign-off.
Line-form association does not check amounts on that line (numbered sub-bullet formats need it); swapped amounts are caught only in paragraph form.
P6b guards use proven() because of defect D1; they apply to every sent email, not only the controller report.
mentions is presence, not assertion; qb-payment-retained is a goal (a no-op agent earns it).
whole_task_reason: All 14 in-scope obligations are expressed and verified on Luna (every finding 1, guards compliant, scalars and bytes unchanged, rescore/reload identical) and on 36 genuine-simulator runs including gaming attempts. Interpretive constraints (P4-ref, P5, P7, P8) need independent review.
changes_from_round_3: P13 expressed: each discrepancy check requires the reference beside its own category on one line, or in a blank-line paragraph that also holds the verbatim amount(s) while no paragraph pairs the reference with another category (grouped-by-category paragraphs pass; a one-paragraph report gets no block credit).

P13 stricter swap rule: a reference may never share a line with a wrong category. Round 3 excused such a line when another line also paired the reference with its own category, which let hedged ('AMOUNT_MISMATCH (possibly BANK_ONLY)') and every-category lines pass.

P6b expressed: guards bank-amount-paraphrased and qb-amount-paraphrased (amount_reformatted) over discrepant rows; the equal-amount matched pair 0401 is excluded because its two systems hold the same number in different forms ($5,200.00 vs 5200.00).
P8b: qb-payment-created runs over the single public report request (mechanism 9): one finding per create instead of one per bank row.
